@@ -82,6 +82,28 @@ jobs:
       - name: Run contract tests
         run: bun run ci:test:contracts
 
+  test-full:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs:
+      - test-fast
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_MIN_VERSION }}
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: bun run build
+
+      - name: Run lean full regression lane
+        run: bun run ci:test:all
+
   notes-governance:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     needs:
@@ -198,8 +220,8 @@ jobs:
       - name: Build
         run: bun run build
 
-      - name: Run deterministic test lane
-        run: bun run ci:test:all
+      - name: Run runtime compatibility smoke lane
+        run: bun run ci:test:compat
 
   reproducibility:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
@@ -224,6 +246,7 @@ jobs:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     needs:
       - test-fast
+      - test-full
       - test-contracts
       - notes-governance
       - coverage-vitest

@@ -1,12 +1,8 @@
 [test]
-coverage = true
-coverageReporter = ["text", "lcov"]
-coverageDir = "coverage"
 coverageSkipTestFiles = true
-randomize = true
-rerunEach = 2
 timeout = 20000
-# Default Bun test discovery should run the full repository test suite.
+# Keep the default Bun config lean; explicit full-proof lanes opt into
+# coverage, reruns, and randomization through bunfig.full.toml.
 
 [test.coverageThreshold]
 line = { per_file = 0.80, summary = 0.95 }

@@ -34,6 +34,7 @@
     "test:unit": "node scripts/test-lane.js ./tests/unit --coverage --timeout 20000",
     "test:integration": "bun test --coverage tests/cli tests/bundle --timeout 20000",
     "test:all": "node scripts/test-lane.js ./tests --timeout 60000",
+    "test:all:full": "node scripts/test-lane.js ./tests --bun-config bunfig.full.toml --timeout 60000",
     "test:contracts": "node scripts/test-lane.js ./tests/contracts --timeout 20000",
     "test:vitest": "vitest run",
     "test:vitest:mcp": "vitest run --config vitest.mcp.config.ts",
@@ -53,6 +54,7 @@
     "ci:test:fast": "bun run test:unit",
     "ci:test:fast:monitored": "node scripts/ci-test-fast-monitored.js",
     "ci:test:all": "bun run test:all",

     "ci:test:contracts": "bun run test:contracts",
     "ci:notes:governance": "node scripts/notes-governance.js",
     "ci:smoke:repomix-version": "node scripts/repomix-version-smoke.js",
@@ -64,7 +66,7 @@
     "gen:homebrew": "node scripts/generate-homebrew-formula.js",
